title: Plan your first two moves with the coach.
goal: Play two thoughtful moves against the coach while protecting your pieces.
narration_seed: Use your first moves to bring pieces into play before trying to attack.
hints: Before each move, ask whether the piece you move will still be protected.
solution_text: There is no single solution; bring your pieces into play and respond to the coach's moves.
success_text: You completed a longer guided plan for your first moves with the coach.
failure_text: Continue the guided plan until you have played two thoughtful moves.
